justification: A second benchmark is justified only if it tests a specific hypothesis that the first benchmark could not.
hypothesis: If multi-agent has any product quality benefit, it should appear on a project with >50 modules where coordination complexity exceeds single-agent capability.

mustPass: P1 product-only >= Vanilla product-only OR product gap <= 2

benchmarkCandidates: Enterprise SaaS: 80+ modules, multi-tenant, complex RBAC
E-commerce platform: 100+ modules, payments, inventory, orders
Healthcare system: 60+ modules, HIPAA compliance, audit trails
falsificationThresholds: If P1 product < Vanilla by >3: REJECT multi-agent for product quality
If P1 composite < Vanilla: REJECT multi-agent entirely
If P1 overhead > 3x: REJECT 4-agent form, require simpler
